theorems.name: Submission.dsmc_firstVariation_eq_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (X : Euclid P → Euclid P), ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ U → AEMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) R.measure → Integrable (fun x => tangentialDivergence n R.carrier X x) R.measure ∧ R.firstVariation X = ∫ x, tangentialDivergence n R.carrier X x ∂R.measure
